```js
// Scratch candidate finder for the decision-lint spike. Offline only.
// Usage: node candidates.mjs <repoRoot> <srcDir>
import fs from "node:fs";
import path from "node:path";
import { createRequire } from "node:module";

const repo = process.argv[2];
const src = process.argv[3] ?? "packages/junior/src";
const require = createRequire(
  path.join(repo, "node_modules/.pnpm/typescript@5.9.3/node_modules/typescript/package.json"),
);
const ts = require("typescript");

const LOG_CALLS = new Set([
  "logWarn", "logError", "logException", "logInfo", "captureException",
  "captureExceptionInScope", "warn", "error",
]);
const EXCEPTION_CALLS = new Set(["logException", "captureException", "captureExceptionInScope"]);

function walkFiles(dir, out = []) {
  for (const e of fs.readdirSync(dir, { withFileTypes: true })) {
    const p = path.join(dir, e.name);
    if (e.isDirectory()) walkFiles(p, out);
    else if (/\.tsx?$/.test(e.name) && !/\.test\.tsx?$/.test(e.name) && !e.name.endsWith(".d.ts")) out.push(p);
  }
  return out;
}

function calleeName(call) {
  const e = call.expression;
  if (ts.isIdentifier(e)) return e.text;
  if (ts.isPropertyAccessExpression(e)) return e.name.text;
  return undefined;
}

/** Visit nodes in a block without entering nested functions. */
function visitShallow(node, fn) {
  ts.forEachChild(node, (child) => {
    if (ts.isFunctionLike(child)) return;
    fn(child);
    visitShallow(child, fn);
  });
}

function enclosingFunction(node) {
  let n = node.parent;
  while (n && !ts.isFunctionLike(n) && !ts.isSourceFile(n)) n = n.parent;
  return n;
}

function line(sf, pos) {
  return sf.getLineAndCharacterOfPosition(pos).line + 1;
}

const out = { swallowed: [], classification: [], jsdoc: [], retry: [] };
for (const file of walkFiles(path.join(repo, src))) {
  const rel = path.relative(repo, file);
  const text = fs.readFileSync(file, "utf8");
  const sf = ts.createSourceFile(file, text, ts.ScriptTarget.Latest, true);
  const visit = (node) => {
    if (ts.isCatchClause(node)) {
      let hasThrow = false, hasLog = false, hasException = false;
      visitShallow(node.block, (n) => {
        if (ts.isThrowStatement(n)) hasThrow = true;
        if (ts.isCallExpression(n)) {
          const name = calleeName(n);
          if (name && LOG_CALLS.has(name)) hasLog = true;
          if (name && EXCEPTION_CALLS.has(name)) hasException = true;
        }
      });
      const fnNode = enclosingFunction(node);
      const rec = {
        file: rel,
        line: line(sf, node.getStart()),
        fnStart: fnNode ? line(sf, fnNode.getStart()) : 1,
        fnEnd: fnNode ? line(sf, fnNode.getEnd()) : line(sf, sf.getEnd()),
      };
      if (hasLog && !hasThrow) out.swallowed.push(rec);
      if (hasException) out.classification.push(rec);
    }
    // Exported functions with a one-line JSDoc.
    const isExported = (n) => n.modifiers?.some((m) => m.kind === ts.SyntaxKind.ExportKeyword);
    if ((ts.isFunctionDeclaration(node) && isExported(node) && node.name)) {
      const docs = ts.getJSDocCommentsAndTags(node).filter(ts.isJSDoc);
      if (docs.length) {
        const doc = docs[docs.length - 1];
        const comment = typeof doc.comment === "string" ? doc.comment : ts.getTextOfJSDocComment(doc.comment) ?? "";
        if (comment.split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean).length <= 8) {
          out.jsdoc.push({ file: rel, line: line(sf, node.getStart()), name: node.name.text, doc: comment });
        }
      }
    }
    // Retry candidates: a catch inside a loop, or a function named *retry*.
    if (ts.isCatchClause(node)) {
      let n = node.parent;
      while (n && !ts.isFunctionLike(n)) {
        if (ts.isForStatement(n) || ts.isWhileStatement(n) || ts.isDoStatement(n) || ts.isForOfStatement(n)) {
          const fnNode = enclosingFunction(node);
          const fnText = fnNode ? fnNode.getText() : "";
          if (/retry|attempt|backoff/i.test(fnText)) {
            out.retry.push({ file: rel, line: line(sf, node.getStart()), fnStart: line(sf, fnNode.getStart()), fnEnd: line(sf, fnNode.getEnd()) });
          }
          break;
        }
        n = n.parent;
      }
    }
    ts.forEachChild(node, visit);
  };
  visit(sf);
}
for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(out)) console.error(k, v.length);
console.log(JSON.stringify(out, null, 1));
```

</details>

## Recommended gate design

**Candidates from changed hunks.** Run the finders only on changed `.ts` files. Keep a candidate only when its catch (or retry loop) range overlaps a changed line in `git diff -U0 <merge-base>...HEAD`. A PR that does not touch a catch costs nothing. Finders should be ast-grep rules under `ast-grep/rules/decision/` with `severity: off`, so the candidate logic is reviewable, testable with `ast-grep/tests`, and shared with deterministic rules.

**Cache key.** `sha256(schema_version, rule_id, question JSON, pinned model id, normalize(candidate), normalize(enclosing function))`. `normalize` collapses whitespace only. Comments stay in the key, because the verdict depends on them. The cache value holds only `{ p_violation, response_model }`: no source, no prompt. CI keeps it in the GitHub Actions cache (restore from `main`). Locally it lives under `git rev-parse --git-path decision-lint/cache` like jevlint, so it cannot be committed. The same code under the same model always gets the same verdict, so reruns are stable and free.

**Threshold.** One threshold per rule, set from the measurement step: the lowest threshold where precision on unambiguous candidates is ≥ 0.8 and no candidate flips across 3 runs. Start at 0.8 if the measurement is thin. Below the threshold, nothing is shown.

**Inline ignore.** Mirror the existing `ast-grep-ignore` comment form:

```ts
// decision-lint-ignore: swallowed-error -- post-delivery persist; throwing re-posts the reply
```

on the line before the `catch`. A missing reason after `--` is a deterministic error. An ignored candidate makes no model call. An ignore is **stale** when no finder candidate starts on the next line, or (in the weekly sweep) when the ignored candidate scores below the threshold. Stale ignores are reported as warnings with the rule id and location. The PR summary lists every ignore that the PR adds, so a reviewer sees each one.

**Fail open.** A provider error, timeout (15 s per call), 429, or a missing key skips that candidate and prints one `decision-lint skipped: <reason>` line. Exit code stays 0. A per-PR budget (50 candidates, 60 s total) skips the rest with the same notice. The gate never blocks a merge because the provider is down.

**CI.** A `decision-lint` job in `ci.yml` runs `pnpm decision-lint:check --base origin/main --format github`. It emits one annotation per finding. It runs only on same-repo PRs, because fork PRs get no secrets, and that is the same fail-open path. Warning-only means the job always exits 0. Failing mode later exits 1 only for rules that have passed measurement.

**Local and agent use.** The same command works locally. `--dry-run` lists candidates, cache hits, and estimated tokens without a model call, so an agent in a sandbox without the key can still see what the gate will judge. With a key, an agent runs it before a PR. That shortens the loop, and the cache makes the CI run free for code the agent already checked.

**Model and provider.** `typesafe-ai/jev` through Vercel AI Gateway. That is the runtime default `decisionModelId` (`packages/junior/src/chat/config.ts`) and the cheapest decision model in `DECISION_INPUT_COST_USD_PER_MILLION_TOKENS` (`packages/junior/src/chat/pi/client.ts`): $0.042/Mtok input, free output. Keep `openai/gpt-6-luna-decisions` ($0.10/Mtok) as the comparison model in the measurement step.

- **Pinning:** TypeSafe docs say that the `jev-latest` alias moves on release (now `jev-1.14.0`). They say to pin a versioned id once thresholds are tuned. We must check whether the Gateway id `typesafe-ai/jev` accepts a pinned version. If not, the gate calls TypeSafe directly with `jev-1.14.0`, as jevlint does with `jev-1.13.0`. Either way, record the response model id and put it in the cache key.
- **Data terms (TypeSafe):** per the [models page](https://docs.typesafe.ai/models), Jev is not trained on customer requests or responses, and zero data retention is for enterprise customers. The [DPA](https://typesafe.ai/legal/data-processing) makes TypeSafe a processor that uses data only to provide the service. The Vercel AI Gateway terms also apply. Someone must confirm Sentry's tier with TypeSafe and Vercel (ZDR or not) before CI sends PR code.

## Comparison

| | Decision-lint (this design) | jevlint ([drevantonder/jevlint](https://github.com/drevantonder/jevlint)) | Warden skill (`warden.toml`) |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| What it is | 2–3 repo rules, worded from our policies, with their exceptions | ~300 generic Jev rules (includes `no-swallowed-error`, `no-log-and-propagate`, `no-unsafe-retry`, `no-undocumented-contract`) | A frontier-model agent that reviews the PR diff against a markdown skill |
| Cost | ~$0.0005 per typical PR, ~$0.02 full sweep (estimate) | Same model and price. More rules mean more questions per file | Not measured here. A frontier agent run per skill per PR, so much higher than a decision call (inference) |
| Determinism | Candidates are deterministic. Verdicts are probabilistic but cached per key, with a pinned model | Same approach: content-addressed cache, pinned `jev-1.13.0` | No verdict cache. Each run can differ |
| Gating | Per-rule threshold, warning first | Never passes or fails; reports probabilities only | Inline PR comments and Checks findings |
| Fit to our policies | High: prompts quote our exceptions (owning edge, typed result, plugins own errors) | Generic. For example, it does not know that a plugin hook failure in core is ok | Medium: the skill text can say anything, but the output is free-form |
| Maintenance | Our finders, prompts, and the benchmark fixture. Re-measure on model bumps | External early proof of concept. Custom rules are spec only today (`docs/custom-rules-spec.md`) | Low per skill; harder to measure precision |

Take from jevlint: the question shape (question, decision boundary, true/false criteria), the cache-key fields, the pinned model, and storing only probabilities. Do not depend on it: we cannot add repo rules to it yet, and it does not gate. In the measurement step, also run jevlint's `no-swallowed-error` question on our benchmark as a baseline. Keep Warden for broad review (security, design), where one narrow yes/no question does not fit.

## Which rules to gate

| Rule | Verdict | Why |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `swallowed-error` | **Gate, warning first** | Highest volume (144 candidates) and the most cited policy. The finder alone is 15% precise. The model must reach ≥0.8 on unambiguous candidates before the rule fails a build. |
| `error-classification` | **Warning only** | Real but subtle. Cross-file context (`isMissing` in the provider) causes false positives. Promote only if measurement shows ≥0.8 precision. |
| `retry-transient-only` | **ast-grep, no model** | Only 8 candidates. "catch in a retry loop with no kind check before the retry" is a syntax check. |
| log-and-rethrow | **ast-grep, no model** | `logException(e, …); throw e;` in the same catch is deterministic. |
| `jsdoc-states-intent` | **Do not gate** | Low value. It conflicts with the "obvious leaf helpers need no comment" exception. 312 candidates would make noise. |

## Rollout

Each step is one scoped PR, except the measurement.

1. **Finders and fixture (no model).** Add `ast-grep/rules/decision/{swallowed-error,error-classification}.yml` (candidate-only) with tests, the benchmark fixture under `tools/decision-lint/fixtures/`, and the prompts. Add `pnpm decision-lint:check --dry-run` that lists changed-hunk candidates.
2. **Deterministic rules.** Add ast-grep rules for log-and-rethrow and unclassified retry. Fix or ignore what they find on `main`, for example `chat/services/persist-retry.ts`.
3. **Measurement (needs approved model access; see below).** Post the results on this issue and set the per-rule thresholds.
4. **Gate runner.** Add the model call, cache, ignore parsing, stale report, budget, and fail-open to `decision-lint:check`. Output only warnings, with `--format github` annotations.
5. **CI, warning only.** Add the `decision-lint` job to `ci.yml`. It always exits 0 and runs on same-repo PRs. Run it for 2–4 weeks, then count annotations that led to a fix vs. an ignore vs. no action.
6. **Fail mode per rule.** Turn on exit 1 only for rules with ≥0.8 measured precision and a low ignore rate in step 5. Add a weekly full sweep that reports stale ignores and score drift.

## Measurement step (needs approved model access)

Someone who is approved to send this repository's code to TypeSafe through Vercel AI Gateway saves `rules.mjs`, `run-benchmark.mjs`, and the two fixture comments (as `part1.json`, `part2.json`) into `packages/junior/` of a checkout at that commit, so `ai` and `@ai-sdk/gateway` resolve. Then they run:

```sh
jq -s '.[0] + {candidates: (.[0].candidates + .[1].candidates)} | del(.part, .rules_in_part)' \
  part1.json part2.json > decision-lint-benchmark.json
DECISION_LINT_APPROVED=1 AI_GATEWAY_API_KEY=… \
  node run-benchmark.mjs decision-lint-benchmark.json \
    --repo ../.. --model typesafe-ai/jev --runs 3
```

Then they run it again with `--model openai/gpt-6-luna-decisions`. Estimated cost is about $0.01 for Jev and $0.02 for Luna. Report per rule: precision and recall at each threshold (all candidates and unambiguous only), cost, p50/p95 latency, error rate, flips across runs, and the response model id. Before this step, add seeded positives (copies of `ok` candidates with the contract comment or typed result removed). With only 4 unambiguous positives, the recall and precision intervals are too wide to set a fail threshold.

## Risks

- **Nondeterminism.** The same input can get a different probability on a new call. The cache makes repeated runs identical. The 3-run stability check rejects thresholds where candidates flip. Warning-only mode limits harm while we learn.
- **Model drift.** An alias can move and change verdicts with no code change. Pin a model version. Put the response model id in the cache key. A version bump is a PR that re-runs the benchmark.
- **Gaming the ignore.** An ignore needs a reason. The PR summary lists new ignores, and stale ignores are reported. A cheaper trick is a comment such as `// best-effort` above a catch that is not. The prompt tells the model to weigh the comment against what the work is for, and the canvas case is in the benchmark to test that. Human review still owns the final call.
- **Prompt injection from code.** Code and comments are evidence, not instructions. The worst case is a false `ok` on one candidate, which is the same as having no gate.
- **Data sent to the provider.** Per candidate: the rule text, the file path, the excerpt, and the enclosing function. The repo is public, but unmerged PR code is not public yet (for example a security fix). Skip the job for PRs with a security label. Never send whole files or diffs outside candidates. Confirm the TypeSafe and AI Gateway retention terms first.
- **Finder recall.** The model only sees what the finder selects. A swallowed error without a log call is not a candidate.

## Related

- getsentry/junior#2308 (repo-defined checks after code changes). Its cheap-first `when` question and "never fail the build until the false-positive rate is known" approach match this gate. The scopes differ: #2308 adds agent obligations in a Turn, and this issue adds a CI and local lint gate.

records.title: 京东售后每日导出 jd3 失败：NPS 调查弹层挡住「查看导出记录」按钮（10-31 09:00 签到）
records.clean_text:
京东售后每日导出 jd3 失败：NPS 调查弹层挡住「查看导出记录」按钮（10-31 09:00 签到）
## 意图
每天 09:00 的京东售后（未收货退款）只读导出，5 家店（jd1/jd2/jd3/jd8/jd5s）都能导出，让后续的仓退货核对有当天的数据。

## 背景
- 2026-10-31 09:00 由「京东仓退货数据表每日签到」Loop 补跑（当天没有导出，按 Loop 规则只跑一次，不自动重试）。
- 结果：jd1、jd2、jd8、jd5s 导出齐（各有 zip）；**jd3 失败**。
- 日志：`D:/硅基公司/员工/06.电商店铺后台专员·骆冰/专项/22.后台售后服务单分析/runtime/logs/daily-jd3-20261031.log`
- 现场截图：`runtime/exports/jd3-unreceived-20261001-20261031-daily-20261031/jd-aftersale-jd3-20261031010351.png`
- 原因（已定位，不是登录态）：点「查看导出记录」（`chakandaochujilu` 那颗按钮）时，` ` 调查弹层拦截了点击，Playwright 重试 60 次后超时。前面「导出」已提交（有 `07-export-submitted.png`），卡的是取记录这一步。

## 验收清单
- [ ] 给 NPS 弹层一个不点交卷、只关闭（或等待消失）的处理，且不误点调查内容
- [ ] jd3 当天重跑能拿到 zip，并且 xlsx 行数与页面总数对得上
- [ ] 其余 4 店不回归（jd1/jd2/jd8/jd5s 同参数跑一次，产物齐）

## 边界（不能牺牲）
- 平台后台只读：不许为了过弹层去提交调查、不许点任何「同意/发布」类按钮。
- 不自动重试、不无脑补跑：修好后由人/我按清单手动验证。
- 只改 22 号项目里的导出脚本，不动其它项目的共享脚本。

## 交接
技术问题归王语嫣跟进（脚本在骆冰 22 号项目，执行人同步）。
records.reason: 弹层遮挡属脚本自动化问题，规则化关闭即可，无需AI能力
